text:
Maya Chen: Quick UX copy nudge for the Embeddings panel tooltip + "Clear cache" confirmation. Current tooltip is wordy/confusing.

Maya Chen: Proposed tooltip variants:
```
Option A: "Embed text to find similar vectors. Supports up to 1024 tokens."
Option B: "Create embeddings for search and similarity. Limits: 1024 tokens."
Option C: "Turn text into vectors for semantic search. Max 1024 tokens."
```
Maya Chen: Which is more approachable for non-ML folks? Also thinking about an aria-label: `aria-label="Embeddings input"` :thinking:

Liam Patel: I like C — "Turn text into vectors" reads friendly. Maybe add "for search" is fine. Suggest small tweak: "Turn text into vectors for semantic search (max 1024 tokens)." :+1:

Samir Gupta: Prefer A for precision. "vectors" is accurate but maybe include an inline helper link to docs. Also prefer keeping "Supports up to 1024 tokens" rather than "max".

Evelyn Park: Accessibility nit — "vectors" might be jargon for some users. Could we try "numeric representation" or "semantic representation"? Also ensure tooltip appears on focus, not only hover. :accessibility:

Maya Chen: Good point. New option D: ```"Turn text into a semantic representation for search (max 1024 tokens)."```

Maya Chen: Now the confirmation dialog for "Clear cache":
```
Heading: "Clear embeddings cache?"
Body (A): "This will remove cached embeddings for this project. New requests may be slower until embeddings are rebuilt. This action cannot be undone."
Primary: "Clear cache"
Secondary: "Cancel"
```
Maya Chen: Short variant:
```
"Remove cached embeddings? Cached results will be regenerated on next request."
Buttons: "Remove" / "Cancel"
```

Samir Gupta: Prefer the first body for clarity. Suggest changing primary label to "Clear cache" and keep secondary "Cancel". Also recommend adding a non-destructive confirm step for orgs with >10k items? Maybe overkill.

Liam Patel: Tone: avoid alarmist language — "This action cannot be undone" is OK, but maybe "Results will be rebuilt on next request" is less scary. Also check that primary button color is the neutral red used for destructive actions.

DocsBot: Copy guide link: https://redwood.internal/docs/ui/copy-guide — section "Confirmation dialogs" has examples. Also note: tooltip length limit is 160 chars on narrow screens.

Evelyn Park: Accessibility checklist: focus trap? screen reader announcement (role="alertdialog" + aria-describedby), keyboard shortcuts, contrast on the primary button.

Maya Chen: Thanks all — I'll draft a tiny PR with tooltip Option C/D and the longer confirmation body. Will include aria-label and sr-only description. Tagging @eng-runtime for the 160-char constraint. :wave:

Liam Patel: :thumbsup:

Samir Gupta: 👍

Evelyn Park: Thanks! :sparkles:
